notes:
**Comments beyond the canvas (CHR-1260 epic, design CHR-1261).** Two features reuse the canvas comment model (CHR-1258): pins anchored to node ids, never coordinates.

**A · Board comments: read-only, click to read** (Christian chose A1 with one change: no hover preview).
- Screens: `board-comments` (default), `board-comments-preview` (pin clicked), `board-comments-detached`, `board-comments-zoomed-out` (below 60%), `board-comments-zoomed-out-list` (dot clicked). All are variants of `board-view`.
- Tiles show `comment-pin`s on their elements. Overlapping pins merge into `comment-pin` `group`. Detached pins sit at the frame's top-left. Name-bar `comment-count-chip`s show open / detached / resolved-hidden.
- The teal `pin-button` keeps the tile's top-right corner, and comment markers never go there.
- Toolbar: `board-toggle` "Comments: On" and "Show resolved".
- A click (never hover) opens `comment-preview`: the latest messages, author, status and **"Open in Screens"**. Reply, resolve and re-anchor happen only in the Screens view.
- Below 60% zoom, one `comment-count-chip` dot per screen sits inside the tile's top-left. **Clicking it opens the screen's read-only thread list** (`comment-preview` `list` of `comment-thread-row`s); a row opens that thread in Screens.

**B · Mockup variant comments: pins in every column** (B1).
- Screens: `mockup-comments-thread`, `mockup-comments-mode`, `mockup-comments-resolved`, `mockup-comments-detached`. All are variants of `chrome-c-mockup-columns`. The Elements panel is dropped while comments show.
- Every column renders its variant's pins. Thread numbers run across the whole mockup.
- `mockup-column-header` (with `variant-badge`) carries per-variant count chips. The popover title shows "#n" + `variant-badge`.
- One comment mode covers all columns (`comment-mode-banner` at the bottom of the stage, `comment-hover-outline` labelled "<variant> · <node>").
- The anchor is `mockup:<mockup>#<variant>.<node-id>`.

**Shared implementation:**
- Every popover is `popover="auto"` + `role="dialog"`.
- CSS anchor positioning: `position-area` + `position-try-fallbacks: flip-inline, flip-block`, gated in `@supports (position-area: block-end)`, with a JS getBoundingClientRect fallback (Firefox).
- Pins and chips are buttons with `aria-expanded`. Focus moves into the popover and returns to its trigger on Esc or close. Tab order follows the tiles or columns.

**Open (architect):** what happens to mockup threads when a mockup is promoted or a variant deleted; the final mockup anchor format.

Use cases: `review-comments-on-board`, `open-thread-from-board`, `comment-on-mockup-variant`, `discuss-mockup-thread`, `agent-answers-mockup-comments`.
